source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The changed wrapper tests verify primary and implicit secondary state and its persistence after refresh, including a multi-source virtual folder. Grouped tests use actual messages because the native sort state is not saved in that real-folder test without them. These assertions demonstrate state persistence; they do not prove every resulting message order or a performance improvement. Keep row-order checks as a separate test requirement for comparator changes.
title: Distinguish sort-state assertions from message-order assertions
